title: Stripe Live secret key: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: missing "_" delimiter between the sk and live segments (the documented sk_live_/sk_test_/rk_live_/rk_test_ prefixes each include it). Twin of "Stripe Live secret key and Stripe Test secret key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of stripe-token-live-plain: boundary: missing "_" delimiter between the sk and live segments (the documented sk_live_/sk_test_/rk_live_/rk_test_ prefixes each include it). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
